title: Copy the Rest
goal: Bump the count; take every other field from the base order.
hints: There is no bare count in scope - the value lives in base.
Two dots before a value fill in every remaining field.
explanation: Inside `bump` there is no standalone `count`; the source value is `base.count` (E0425 otherwise, and Rust has no `++`). For the rest, struct update syntax `..base` copies every remaining field and must come last. Writing `base` alone looks like field shorthand for a field named base (E0560), and listing only `id` leaves `express` missing (E0063).
